enemy_intelligence.basis: Qin operational intelligence synthesis from campaign activity and forces able to reach the selected theater within roughly two days

campaign_context.objective: participate in major Qin operation against northern Wei while Qin court power is divided; execute the institutional order with the assigned Qin formations under Tang Wei's current field-command authority

operational_area.selection_basis: nearest lawful friendly strategic staging node on the approach to the target theater

claim: Qin Military Bureau operational briefing. Campaign objective: participate in major Qin operation against northern Wei while Qin court power is divided; execute the institutional order with the assigned Qin formations under Tang Wei's current field-command authority. Tang Wei's present field command is 9,500 troops in 19 formation(s), currently at Qin Eastern Military Depot. Other Qin forces formally tied to this campaign: 73,200 troops in 3 formation(s), under Kanki, Mou Gou, Ousen, at Qin Capital Basin, Qin Northern Frontier, task: maintain military readiness; 46,100 troops in 2 formation(s), under Ouki, Tou, at Qin Eastern March, task: protect core territory; 40,000 troops in 1 formation(s), under Mou Bu, at Qin Southern March, task: maintain military readiness; 5,000 troops in 1 formation(s), under Fan Yi, at Qin Capital Basin, task: maintain military readiness; 3,000 troops in 1 formation(s), under Shou Hei Kun, at Qin Eastern Military Depot, task: protect core territory. Combined Qin strength represented by those current operation owners is 176,800. Current operational area selected by staff planning is Kanyou. Immediate lawful staging is Kanyou; hostile entry is not yet authorized, so Sanyou remains the strategic target rather than the current march destination. Enemy picture: an official estimate of roughly 94,000-156,000 troops able to influence the theater; reported opposing commanders: Gai Mou, Jing Rong, Rei Ou, Deng Shan, Go Hou Mei, Huan Zhen, Jing Ning, Luo Qian, Qiao He, Qiao Jie; no confirmed battle contact. These enemy figures are command-intelligence estimates, not omniscient exact truth. Executable staff packet: phase campaign_muster_and_staging; concentrate/report at Qin Eastern Military Depot, then operate toward Kanyou when the commander executes the order. Success condition: the current field command physically assembles at the lawful staging area and completes deployment. Arrival at staging causes a field-command situation report. Crossing into the target state still requires lawful war/entry authority and does not happen automatically.
